_metadata.title: DoseWeave Verified Medication Safety & Interaction Knowledge Base
sources: U.S. FDA FAERS (Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System)
DailyMed Structured Product Labeling (National Library of Medicine)
Lexicomp / DrugBank Clinical Pharmacology Reference Standards
_metadata.verification_policy: Only pharmacologically validated interactions are included. Unknown or speculative interactions are flagged for pharmacist review.

drug_drug_interactions.effect: Markedly elevated hemorrhage risk; dual antiplatelet and anticoagulant synergistic bleeding.
Severe gastrointestinal bleeding and elevated prothrombin time displacement.
Additive antiplatelet effect; requires clinical supervision for bleeding risks.
Severe hyperkalemia risk causing potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
Severe hyperkalemia; ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone secretion, retaining potassium.
Acute renal impairment leading to potential lactic acidosis.
CYP3A4 inhibition increases statin exposure, causing high risk of rhabdomyolysis.
Severe myopathy and rhabdomyolysis due to CYP3A4 inhibition.
Synergistic serotonergic activity elevating risk of life-threatening Serotonin Syndrome.
Potential Serotonin Syndrome and lowered seizure threshold.
Profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and potential fatality.
Dual CNS and respiratory depression; concurrent opioid-benzodiazepine hazard.
Decreased methotrexate renal clearance leading to severe bone marrow suppression.
Displacement from protein binding and decreased tubular secretion; acute toxicity.
Profound synergistic vasodilation causing severe, potentially fatal hypotension.
Doubles serum digoxin concentrations; fatal digitalis toxicity risk.
Severe additive negative inotropic and chronotropic effects; high-grade AV block.
CYP1A2 inhibition elevates theophylline levels causing neurotoxicity and seizures.
Chelation in GI tract impairs levothyroxine absorption; separate doses by 4 hours.
Insoluble chelate complex formed; reduces thyroid replacement efficacy.
Marked increase in Achilles tendonitis and risk of tendon rupture.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme inhibition increases systemic statin exposure.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Avoid large amounts of grapefruit and grapefruit juice to prevent muscle breakdown.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibition elevates bioavailability up to 7-fold.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Complete avoidance of grapefruit products is clinically advised.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Increased serum calcium channel blocker levels resulting in peripheral edema and hypotension.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Limit grapefruit intake while on calcium channel blockers.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Alcohol potentiates metformin's effect on lactate metabolism.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Avoid acute or chronic excessive alcohol consumption to prevent lactic acidosis.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Ethanol induces CYP2E1, accelerating formation of hepatotoxic metabolite NAPQI.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Strictly avoid alcohol when taking acetaminophen/paracetamol.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Ethanol induces CYP2E1, elevating NAPQI hepatotoxic load.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Do not consume alcohol with acetaminophen.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Synergistic GABA-A receptor stimulation causes severe CNS depression.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Strictly avoid alcohol; high risk of severe sedation and respiratory depression.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Synergistic GABA-A receptor stimulation causes severe CNS depression.
Additive central nervous system and respiratory suppression.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Do not consume alcohol with tramadol.

drug_food_interactions.food_category: High Vitamin K Foods (Spinach, Kale, Broccoli)
drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Vitamin K directly reverses anticoagulant antagonism of clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Maintain consistent daily dietary vitamin K intake; sudden increases reduce INR and promote clotting.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Divalent calcium ions form unabsorbable chelates with fluoroquinolones.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Take ciprofloxacin 2 hours before or 6 hours after dairy products.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Calcium binding in digestive tract reduces doxycycline bioavailability.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Separate doxycycline and dairy products by at least 2 hours.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Competitive xanthine metabolism; caffeine elevates theophylline serum levels.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Limit caffeinated beverages to prevent tachycardia, jitteriness, and tremors.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: Additive sympathomimetic stimulation increases heart rate and blood pressure.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Reduce caffeine consumption while taking oral decongestants.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: St. John's Wort contains hyperforin and hypericin, adding serotonergic toxicity.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Avoid St. John's Wort due to high risk of Serotonin Syndrome.

drug_food_interactions.mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4, clearing ethinyl estradiol and causing breakthrough ovulation.
drug_food_interactions.recommendation: Avoid St. John's Wort; barrier contraception required.

disease_contraindications.warning: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandins, reducing glomerular filtration and worsening renal failure.
NSAID-induced acute kidney injury and fluid retention.
Inhibition of COX-1 impairs gastric mucosal protective prostaglandins, worsening ulcers.
High risk of upper gastrointestinal perforation, ulceration, and bleeding.
Non-cardioselective beta blockade can induce bronchospasm.
Potential bronchoconstriction at higher therapeutic dosages.
Alpha-1 adrenergic vasoconstriction can trigger severe hypertensive crises.
Glucocorticoids induce hepatic gluconeogenesis and peripheral insulin resistance.

allergy_cross_reactions.warning: Shared beta-lactam core structure presents high risk of acute anaphylaxis.
Cross-reactive NSAID hypersensitivity (Samter's Triad / bronchospasm / urticaria).
Sulfonamide antimicrobial cross-reactivity; risk of severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SCAR).
